name: M1 Abrams
protection: Composite (Chobham-derived, depleted-uranium inserts on US tanks) turret front; TUSK kit adds reactive tiles and rear slat; some SEP v2/v3 carry Trophy APS. Game rule: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, tracks and exposed crew; penetrating the hull needs launchers (RPG-7 PG-7V, AT4, MAAWS, SMAW, NLAW, Javelin) or cannon. Side/rear and engine deck are the launcher weak points.
visual_notes: Flat, wide, sharply angled turret with large rear bustle rack
7 road wheels per side, rear drive sprocket, full-length side skirts
Long 120 mm gun with thermal sleeve and muzzle reference sensor
CROWS remote weapon station on commander's position; CITV sight box on turret roof (SEP)
Gas-turbine exhaust grille on hull rear
TUSK: reactive armour tiles on skirts, slat on rear
